visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white historical-style engraving depicting a chaotic scene of conflict. In the foreground, a man in 18th-century European colonial attire stands with his arm raised, appearing to shout or protest. Beside him, a woman in a long dress and bonnet looks distressed. They are being led or escorted by a shirtless man wearing a feathered headdress and a loincloth, who carries a musket and a bundle of fabric. In the background, there is a stone fort or building, and other figures are engaged in a skirmish or battle, with some individuals lying on the ground.
